items.quote: I have been working with Tarpon Lawn and Pest for the past 4 years and we just wrapped up our largest project yet - sod on the entire property and correcting all the irrigation (we had a pool installed and the builder broke every line). Rian has been so patient and so easy to work with, it has been especially apparent after working with so many terrible vendors during the course of the pool build. I'm grateful for his guidance and exceptional work and I plan to work with him for many years to come!

We are extremely happy with the work Rian & his partner did on my landscape project. From start to finish, their communication was clear, prompt, and professional. They kept me informed every step of the way and made sure all my questions were answered. The quality of the work was top-notch, and the team was friendly, respectful, and efficient. I already have a few more projects in mind and will definitely be hiring them again.

Rian and his team are incredible! The amount of knowledge that he has with plants and landscaping is astounding. We contacted many landscaping companies but because of the shade and the oak trees in my yard, Rian told me exactly what would and wouldn't work specifically for my home, no other company did that. There is no one else I'd trust more than him. Highly recommend!
